items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: Moody’s triplet. Moody’s triplets. I still don’t understand, even though Mike explained it.

ctx.x: Dizzy was the one — and Mike Longo, the work he’s done in preserving his legacy is just mind blowing, historic, should be preserved, and those DVDs should be on every jazz musician’s shelf. There’s stuff on there I never heard of. Moody’s triplet. Moody’s triplets. I still don’t understand, even though Mike explained it. You know.
Well you mentioned something in passing, that one of the last generations that enjoyed or employed the apprenticeship —
